capabilities: Resolves natural-language date and time expressions into links or timestamps
Suggests dates from an @ trigger with live previews
Inserts current date, time, or timestamp via commands
Opens daily notes through a URI action
Configures languages, formats, and periodic-note link formats
extras: Beta builds available via BRAT; suggestion history stored in history.json (max 100 entries); TypeScript API documented in API.md; MIT licensed.
intentEvidence: This is a revived and improved version of the popular "Natural Language Dates" plugin for Obsidian.
motivation: To revive the unmaintained Natural Language Dates plugin with a modern engine, true multilingual support, and smarter time handling.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to type plain-language date expressions and have them resolved into date links or timestamps while writing.

relations.evidence: This is a revived and improved version of the popular "Natural Language Dates" plugin for Obsidian.
Optional formats for linking to weekly/monthly/quarterly/yearly notes (e.g. used by the Periodic Notes plugin)

summary: Autocomplete plugin that turns natural-language date and time expressions like @today into formatted dates, links, and periodic-note links, in many languages.
